notes.title: Wob 1.3
notes.content:
WOB version 1.3, a new update with significant features, has activated the new TOWER DEFENSE mode, along with many improvements to the standard game.

[h3]Changed Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tower Defense game mode has been added,
[*] along with performance improvements,
[*] new objects, and additional textures.
[*] Both 3rd and 1st person cameras have also been included.
[/list]

notes.title: WOB 1.2 - New - Gameplay Mode
notes.content:
Improvements:
[list]
[*] Correction - Menu translations.
[*] New - Menu Design.
[*] New - Gameplay Mode: (Third and first-person)
[*] Addition of new translations.
[/list]

With the new gameplay mode, it is now possible to explore the world you've built in a completely new way. More updates and features will be added to this mode in the future.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] 
[*] Added new translations
[*] Added help option
[*] Added shortcuts for opening screens
[*] Added a preview of objects and shapes before insertion
[*] Added the possibility to rotate the piece before inserting
[/list]

[b]Adjustments and Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted character limit from 3 to 10 in user creation
[*] Adjusted character limit from 6 to 15 in map creation
[*] Fixed bug that allowed selecting more than one piece insertion tool
[*] Fixed bug when scrolling within a screen that also zoomed in on the game scene
[*] Fixed player movement
[*] Standardized sizes of options in the main scene
[/list]

notes.title: Initial Version Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug fixes for the HUD in some languages like German.
[*] Added the option to delete maps in the main menu.
[*] Adjustments in German translation.
[*] HUD adjustments for different resolutions.
[/list]
